messages.subject: Verdant — board pack timing
messages.plaintextBody:
Sarah,

Separate to Drake — on Verdant Energy (Project Onyx), can you confirm whether the next quarterly board pack is due before or after the December meeting? Our internal reporting deadline is the 5th and I want to make sure the management accounts line up. Happy to take this offline if easier.

Eleanor
